summary: Iteration 19: Tested the required certificates per staff group setting, the certificate reminder preview (preview=true only; the reminder was never sent for real), the admin starter progress view, check-in booking with private events, the completion alert link and Pronathi's removal. Backend: 16/16 new tests pass, and the iter18 suite (updated for the new alert link and recipients) also passes, 27/27 in total. Frontend (375x667): the Compliance screen shows the Required certs and Remind staff buttons, the confirm sheet appears with a count of 33 and Cancel closes it, the red '1 required missing' badge and details show, and 'View starter checklist' opens /starter/{id}. The /starter screen shows progress, the steps (the certificate step lists 'Still needed: NDIS Worker Screening'), the check-ins list and the booking form; a bad date shows an error toast and a valid dd-mm-yyyy date books the check-in and it appears in the list. On /cert-requirements, adding, case-insensitive dedupe and removing all work. No bugs blocking these features. No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: Accepts any user (not only New Starter groups) and past dates; there is no endpoint to cancel or delete a booked check-in.
